finding: TextView setMaxLines(n) sets line-mode maximum, and StaticLayout.Builder receives that maximum as setMaxLines(...). A five-line max can therefore bound the text layout itself, contradicting the promise that later Evidence/Source remains available by vertical scrolling. Pixel-height mode instead leaves the StaticLayout line budget unbounded while capping measured view height.
